      playerNumber - the number of players in the game

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Entry point of the game program. Prompts the user to enter the number of players, creates a new Game instance, and conducts rounds until win condition is reached. Once the game ends, it retrieves the winners using getWinner() and prints out the winning players.
      Parameters:
      args -

      public static void setPlayerArray(int playerNumber)

      Parameters:

    • doPlayerTurn

      public static void doPlayerTurn(Player player)
      Executes a player's turn by presenting three available options, Draw tokens, Reserve a card and Buy a card The player is repeatedly prompted to enter a choice until a valid action is performed.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose turn is being executed

    • nobleSelection

      public static void nobleSelection(Player p)
      Prompts the Player to choose a noble if more than 1 visits and adds the noble to the Player
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose turn is being executed

    • hitWinCondition

      public static boolean hitWinCondition(Player p)
      Checks whether the player has met the win condition. The win condition is reached when the player's points total is 15.
      Parameters:
      p - the Player being checked
      Returns:
      true if the player has reached the win condition, false otherwise

    • getWinner

      public static List<Player> getWinner()
      Checks if the player’s points are equal to or more than 15.

      p - the Player being checked.
      Returns:
      true if the player has reached the win condition, false otherwise

      public static List<NobleTile> visitingNobles(Player p)

    • reserveCard

      public static boolean reserveCard(Player p)
      Performs the reserve card action. The Player selects a card to reserve, and receives 1 gold if the bank has gold available.
      Parameters:
      p - the Player performing the action
      Returns:
      true if the action was successfully performed, false otherwise

    • buyCard

      public static boolean buyCard(Player p)
      Performs the buy card action. The Player selects a card to buy, and the player's tokens and the bank are updated accordingly.
      Parameters:
      p - the Player performing the action
      Returns:
      true if the action was successfully performed, false otherwise

    • drawToken

      public static boolean drawToken(Player currentPlayer)
      Performs the draw token action. The Player may choose to take 2 tokens of the same type, 3 tokens of different types, or cancel action. If the Player has more than 10 tokens, prompts the user to return excess The Player's tokens and the bank are updated accordingly.
      Parameters:
      p - the Player performing the action
      Returns:
      true if the action was successfully performed, false otherwise
